description: ENHANCED: path/URL resolution edge cases — default "/" when neither path nor rawPath is present, and method derived from request-context for a raw-path-only v1 event with a query string.

cases.expected_output:

request.url=/
[response]
status=200
isBase64Encoded=false
body={"root":true}
header.connection=keep-alive
header.content-length=13
header.content-type=application/json; charset=utf-8
header.date=<present>

[request]
request.url=/items?page=2
request.query.page=2
[response]
status=200
isBase64Encoded=false
body={"ok":1}

header.content-type=application/json; charset=utf-8
